overview.zh: 桌面上位机由入口分发到 Qt UI/CLI；HandBackend 汇聚命令和状态，主协议负责串口字节编码。ROS2 两类 subscriber 与 Replay 走不同输入路径，但最终都受 backend/controller 准入约束。
overview.en: The desktop dispatches from its entry point to Qt UI/CLI. HandBackend aggregates commands and state, while the main protocol handles serial bytes. ROS2 subscribers and Replay use distinct input paths, but all remain subject to backend/controller admission.

zh.plain: desktop.app.entry.main 解析 ui/cli 子命令和参数，再把 mode、端口、ROS2 topic、输入空间及 auto_start 传给对应 runner。
zh.condition: 用户启动 `python -m desktop ui` 或 `python -m desktop cli` 后进入；未提供命令时打印帮助并正常返回。
zh.effect: UI 分支调用 run_ui；CLI 分支调用 run_cli_monitor。ROS2 参数经 _resolve_ros_topic 统一解析。
zh.failure: 未知子命令由 argparse 报错；参数能解析不代表串口或 ROS2 运行环境已就绪。
zh.recovery: 按 README 选择 ui 或 cli 命令；遇到启动失败先核对参数、依赖和所选端口。
zh.unknown: 入口只做参数分发，不证明界面线程、ROS executor 或通信连接正常。
zh.difference: 此节点是进程入口；HandBackend 在应用构建后提供共同业务 API。
zh.change: 基线未标记入口为本次变更。

en.plain: desktop.app.entry.main parses ui/cli subcommands and passes mode, ports, ROS2 topic, input space, and auto_start to the selected runner.
en.condition: Entered by `python -m desktop ui` or `python -m desktop cli`; with no command it prints help and returns normally.
en.effect: The UI branch calls run_ui and the CLI branch calls run_cli_monitor. ROS2 topic arguments are resolved through _resolve_ros_topic.
en.failure: argparse rejects unknown subcommands; successful parsing does not prove serial or ROS2 runtime readiness.
en.recovery: Choose the ui or cli command from the README; check arguments, dependencies, and ports if startup fails.
en.unknown: The entry point only dispatches arguments; it does not prove UI-thread, ROS executor, or communication health.
en.difference: This is the process entry point; HandBackend provides the shared business API after app construction.
en.change: The baseline does not mark the entry point as changed.

zh.plain: Qt HandGUI 提供按钮、通道表格、状态显示和 ROS2 输入信号；ROS executor 线程通过 Qt Signal 将目标转到 GUI 线程，避免跨线程直接操作 widget。
zh.condition: 在 `--command ui` 路径下由 run_ui 创建；具体控制取决于当前模式和按钮事件。
zh.effect: UI 发出的 ENABLE、STOP、scope、Replay 等动作交给 controller facade/context，再由 HandBackend 与 HandController 处理。
zh.failure: 控件可点击不等于命令已获准；控制器状态、设备连接和 P4 ACK 可让操作被拒绝。
zh.recovery: 先看状态栏和故障详情；按模式切换到允许的页面，确认连接和 scope 后再操作。
zh.unknown: 静态架构未覆盖 Qt 事件循环卡顿或显示线程实时性。
zh.difference: UI 负责呈现和发起意图，安全校验与协议发送在 backend/controller/P4。
zh.change: 基线未标记 UI 节点为本次变更。

en.plain: Qt HandGUI presents buttons, channel tables, status, and ROS2 input signals. The ROS executor thread uses a Qt Signal to move targets to the GUI thread instead of touching widgets directly.
en.condition: Created by run_ui on the `--command ui` path; actual actions depend on the selected mode and button event.
en.effect: UI actions such as ENABLE, STOP, scope, and Replay pass through the controller facade/context to HandBackend and HandController.
en.failure: A clickable control does not mean the command is admitted; controller state, device connectivity, and P4 ACK can reject it.
en.recovery: Read status and fault details; switch to a mode that allows the action, then verify connection and scope.
en.unknown: The static architecture does not cover Qt event-loop stalls or display-thread timing.
en.difference: The UI presents and initiates intent; validation and protocol sending occur in backend/controller/P4.
en.change: The baseline does not mark the UI node as changed.

zh.plain: HandBackend 是 UI、ROS2 与 CLI 共用的应用层门面，管理 HandController 生命周期、状态分发、触觉串口和控制命令 API。
zh.condition: 由 runner 构造并传给 UI/CLI；各调用方通过其公开方法请求动作。
zh.effect: 后端把关节目标、控制模式、Replay、校准和 ROS2 命令转给底层 controller，并维护上层授权与状态。
zh.failure: 后端可能因未授权、未连接、未启动或 scope 不匹配而拒绝；返回 JointCommandResult 需要检查 sent/message。
zh.recovery: 读命令返回值、status 和 drop reason；不要仅凭 API 被调用就认定命令已写入串口。
zh.unknown: 图中列出架构边界，未展开每一个后端门禁及所有数据锁。
zh.difference: Backend 是应用编排层，不是独立安全认证或 P4 固件本身。
zh.change: 基线未标记后端节点为本次变更。

en.plain: HandBackend is the application facade shared by UI, ROS2, and CLI. It manages HandController lifecycle, state fan-out, tactile serial, and the control-command API.
en.condition: Constructed by a runner and passed to UI/CLI; callers request actions through its public methods.
en.effect: It delegates joint targets, control modes, Replay, calibration, and ROS2 commands to the lower controller while maintaining host-side authorization and state.
en.failure: The backend can reject requests when unarmed, disconnected, not started, or scope-mismatched; callers must inspect JointCommandResult.sent/message.
en.recovery: Read return values, status, and drop reason; a method call alone does not prove a serial write.
en.unknown: The architecture shows layer boundaries, not every backend guard or data lock.
en.difference: Backend is an application orchestration layer, not a standalone safety certification or the P4 firmware.
en.change: The baseline does not mark the backend node as changed.

zh.plain: 主串口协议模块把命令 ID 和 payload 编码为 FE/LEN/CMD/PAYLOAD/FF，并由共享协议定义校验长度。
zh.condition: 由 HandController 的通信操作调用；每个命令必须匹配定义的 payload schema。
zh.effect: build frame 校验命令与长度，接收解析器反向识别 packet 并更新状态。
zh.failure: 未知 command 或长度不匹配会拒绝组帧；链路校验失败也可能丢弃输入帧。
zh.recovery: 用协议定义和生成器 --check 检查主机/固件同步，再查看 ACK 和解析诊断。
zh.unknown: 协议静态正确不证明串口链路无丢包或 P4 端执行成功。
zh.difference: 这是桌面与 P4 的字节级边界；HandBackend 使用的是更高层的业务对象。
zh.change: 基线未标记协议节点为本次变更。

en.plain: The main serial protocol encodes command IDs and payloads as FE/LEN/CMD/PAYLOAD/FF and validates lengths against shared definitions.
en.condition: Called by HandController communication operations; each command must match its defined payload schema.
en.effect: The frame builder validates command and size; receive parsers identify packets and update state.
en.failure: Unknown commands or size mismatches reject frame construction; link integrity failures can discard received frames.
en.recovery: Use protocol definitions and generator --check to verify host/firmware consistency, then inspect ACK and parser diagnostics.
en.unknown: Static protocol correctness does not prove a lossless serial link or successful P4 execution.
en.difference: This is the byte-level desktop/P4 boundary; HandBackend uses higher-level business objects.
en.change: The baseline does not mark the protocol node as changed.

zh.plain: Raw IK bridge 接收外部 21 关节 Float32MultiArray，交由 JointTargetCommandHandler 做长度/值/输入空间处理，再调用 backend 的授权关节目标路径。
zh.condition: 需以 `--ros2-input raw_ik` 启动并配置 topic；在 UI 中还要明确开启 ROS2 output 授权。
zh.effect: bridge subscription → handler → backend.send_ros2_joint_targets；armed scope 限定可发关节。
zh.failure: bridge 未启动、值无效、serial/controller 不就绪、scope 变化或 output 未 armed 时请求被 drop。
zh.recovery: 检查 topic 数据、输入空间和 drop reason；切 scope 后需重新确认授权状态。
zh.unknown: 订阅接收不意味着可控输出，静态图也不证明物理关节响应。
zh.difference: Raw IK 与 joint-target subscriber 使用的配置/语义不同，不能混用 topic 约定。
zh.change: 基线未标记该节点为本次变更。

en.plain: The Raw IK bridge receives external 21-joint Float32MultiArray data, sends it through JointTargetCommandHandler for size/value/input-space handling, then calls the backend’s authorized joint-target path.
en.condition: Start with `--ros2-input raw_ik` and configure the topic; also explicitly enable ROS2 output authorization in the UI.
en.effect: bridge subscription → handler → backend.send_ros2_joint_targets; the armed scope restricts which joints may be sent.
en.failure: The request is dropped if the bridge is stopped, values are invalid, serial/controller is not ready, scope changes, or output is not armed.
en.recovery: Inspect topic data, input space, and drop reason; re-confirm authorization after changing scope.
en.unknown: Receiving a subscription does not authorize control, and this static graph does not prove physical joint response.
en.difference: Raw IK and the joint-target subscriber use different configuration/semantics; do not mix their topic contracts.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this node as changed.

zh.plain: Joint-target subscriber 是另一个 ROS2 输入入口，订阅配置的 Float32MultiArray 并送到 JointTargetCommandHandler；其输入空间参数与 raw_ik bridge 分开配置。
zh.condition: 启用 joint-target ROS2 input 并把 publisher 与订阅器的 topic、数组顺序、单位约定对齐。
zh.effect: subscription 回调把消息交给 handler，再经 HandBackend 的 ROS2 授权和 joint scope 路径发送。
zh.failure: 消息格式错误、授权关闭或后端状态门禁失败都会让目标被忽略/拒绝。
zh.recovery: 查看当前输入模式与 handler warning；不要把它和 `/raw_ik_target` 的 raw IK 约定混为一谈。
zh.unknown: 本图只显示订阅结构，不证明 publisher 发值的单位、来源或安全性。
zh.difference: 它与 raw_ik 共用目标处理思路，但两种输入模式的格式/配置并不等同。
zh.change: 基线未标记该节点为本次变更。

en.plain: The joint-target subscriber is a separate ROS2 input path. It subscribes to a configured Float32MultiArray and passes it to JointTargetCommandHandler; its input-space setting is separate from the raw_ik bridge.
en.condition: Enable joint-target ROS2 input and align topic, array order, and units with the publisher.
en.effect: The subscription callback hands messages to the handler, then the HandBackend ROS2 authorization and joint-scope path.
en.failure: Malformed messages, disabled authorization, or backend state gates can cause targets to be ignored or rejected.
en.recovery: Check the active input mode and handler warnings; do not confuse it with the raw IK contract on `/raw_ik_target`.
en.unknown: This graph shows the subscription structure, not the publisher’s value provenance or safety.
en.difference: It shares target-handling concepts with raw_ik, but the input modes and configuration are not interchangeable.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this node as changed.

zh.plain: Replay 控制把记录轨迹按时间送给后端；ReplayStatus 记录 frame index、时长、targets 和 joint masks，也记录跳过/限幅等信息。
zh.condition: 由 replay runner/service 控制；启动是否允许还受 P4 system_state、串口与 controller ready 约束。
zh.effect: Replay service 按采样时间发送 joint targets，后端再走控制器和协议；取消/复位路径可停止并清理回放。
zh.failure: 状态不允许、通信不可用、数据帧越界或控制端拒绝都会令 replay 无法继续。
zh.recovery: 查看 ReplayStatus 的 message/warnings、当前 frame 与 masks；处理故障后重新开始。
zh.unknown: 轨迹在静态文件中存在不证明机械手能安全复现，需验证来源、scope 和实机状态。
zh.difference: Replay 发送的是有时间轴的记录目标，与 ROS2 实时输入的时序来源不同。
zh.change: 基线未标记该节点为本次变更。

en.plain: Replay control sends recorded trajectories to the backend over time. ReplayStatus tracks frame index, duration, targets, joint masks, and skipped/clamped warnings.
en.condition: Controlled by the replay runner/service; start admission also depends on P4 system_state, serial connectivity, and controller readiness.
en.effect: The service sends joint targets at recorded sample times; the backend then uses controller/protocol paths. Cancel/reset can stop and clear replay.
en.failure: Disallowed state, missing communication, invalid frame indices, or controller rejection can prevent progress.
en.recovery: Inspect ReplayStatus message/warnings, current frame, and masks; resolve the blocker before starting again.
en.unknown: A static trajectory file does not prove safe mechanical playback; verify its source, scope, and hardware state.
en.difference: Replay uses time-indexed recorded targets, unlike live ROS2 input.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this node as changed.
